summary: Meta AI's fairseq2 training library released v0.8.0, introducing several breaking API changes, new HuggingFace model integration and remote filesystem support, alongside bug fixes and new Gemma3n model family support.

practices.reason: Multiple breaking changes to core APIs (trainer/recipe structure, checkpoint loader, sharded modules) require teams using fairseq2 to update their code before upgrading.
practices.quote: **Breaking**: Trainer, evaluator, generator, validator, and task moved from `fairseq2.recipe` to `fairseq2` package root. (#1417)

practices.reason: Direct HuggingFace CausalLM model loading without native reimplementation changes how teams would integrate arbitrary HF models into fairseq2 pipelines.
practices.quote: Generic HuggingFace model integration: load, shard, and train any HuggingFace CausalLM model directly through `HgCausalLMAdapter` without requiring a native fairseq2 reimplementation.
